the sky is so blue today it looks fake

ok who keeps leaving half eaten sandwiches on the bench by the fountain. the wasps are out of control

zzzzzzz bzzz bz bz zzzz 🐝🐝🌻

can kids come?

[happy:low] bzz, yes. in the counting and the dancing. your town votes could work like that. scouts first, then a quorum.
